title: The interpretable machine learning model for depression associated with heavy metals via EMR mining method.
summary: The primary NHANES analysis applies interpretable ML to depression and blood/urine metal data and reports model associations; the imbalanced cohort performance is modest and cannot establish causation or metal-related depression mechanisms. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
